message: "No, never mind."

name: Ms. Librarian

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "What was his name?"

name: Shiori

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A man in his fifties who knows me..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Tetsuya-san..."

name: Shiori

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Something... to tell him..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If you do meet him again..."

name: Shiori

name: Shiori

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "As I mentioned last time, I focused on incidents and accidents from five years ago."

name: Ms. Librarian

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There *was* a major case that caused a stir, but once you narrow the victims down to high school girls, there really isn't much to find."

name: Shiori
message: "A major case? Can you tell us more?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A serial murder case. Or more accurately, a serial kidnapping and murder case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "All of the victims were preschool-age girls. It's commonly referred to as the Preschool Girl Serial Murder Case, or the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I was going to say it was likely unrelated to you—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "—but it looks like something caught your attention."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah... you're right. There's something about that case that's tugging at me."

name: Shiori
message: "Actually, I saw the ghost of a young girl yesterday. I was planning to ask you about that."

name: Shiori
message: "Could she have been one of the victims? No, it might be too hasty to connect her to the case as of now."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I can't really say, but if it's bothering you, it should be worth looking into."

name: Shiori
message: "Can you tell us more about the case?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I skimmed through it since I assumed it was irrelevant, so I don't know enough to explain it properly."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'd love to help investigate outside as well, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Really? That's very reassuring."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I can't, unfortunately. I'm unable to leave this library."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm what you'd call a bound spirit, tied down by lingering regrets, and—ah, never mind. My circumstances don't matter."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm sorry if I raised your expectations."

name: Shiori
message: "I see. I guess even ghosts have their own troubles."

name: Shiori
message: "But thank you. Just knowing you feel that way makes me happy."

name: Shiori
message: "I guess we'll just check online, then."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes, that would be faster. I'll look into it on my end as well."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "For cases like this, gossip magazines tend to be more useful than newspapers, though I'm not sure how many are still archived now that five years have passed..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'll do what I can. Give me some time."

name: Shiori

name: Shiori

name: Ms. Librarian

name: Ms. Librarian

name: Shiori

name: Shiori

name: Shiori
message: "But she really does know a lot... so we can't just avoid her either."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello, ma'am."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You know, I love those cookies, but it looks like they've raised their prices again."

name: Shiori
message: "Ma'am?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I should know! I ate some yesterday! It's deplorable, outright deplorable! How deplorable can they get!"

name: Shiori
message: "I didn't expect her to ignore me. Hmm, what now..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh my goodness, you! What are you doing! Why aren't you in school?!"

name: Shiori
message: "Wah—that startled me... School's—"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Wandering around a place like this since morning? Don't blame me if the police pick you up."

name: Shiori
message: "No, um, there's something I wanted to ask you—"

message: "You know I don't like Yasuda-san one bit why did he even get elected there's definitely something shady going on people who look nice on the surface are always hiding something..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ma'am."

name: Gossiping Woman

name: Shiori
message: "Ma'am, there's something I want to ask you."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What do you want?! Didn't anyone teach you to listen when someone's talking?!"

name: Shiori

message: "Oh my, a lost child? How awful!"

name: Shiori
message: "Have you seen her? She's a small girl, maybe five or six years old—"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "A girl!"

name: Shiori
message: "Ring any bells?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I feel so sorry for the Kirishikis. Their daughter killed herself, you see. And she was still in high school, too."

name: Shiori
message: "Just when I thought the conversation was actually going somewhere... Looks like I was wrong..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What was her name again... It was... uhh... hmm... what was it... Yu... yu... yu..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Ah, Nagisa! Right, Nagisa! It was Nagisa-chan!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I heard she jumped from her apartment building! I wonder what happened..."

name: Shiori
message: "From her apartment...? Did she climb over the railing?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "How should I know that?! But I do know this! That girl might've looked like a model student, but she was actually seeing a delinquent!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "It was a man, I tell you! A man! She let some awful guy string her along until he finally tossed her aside. Poor thing, no eye for men at all!"

name: Shiori
message: "Jumped from her apartment... Kirishiki, Nagisa..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Girls like her always fall for the worst types. The goodie two-shoes ones always want a little adventure, you know? So foolish."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "It was the same with the Uribayashis. Their daughter picked the wrong man too. Her parents raised her wrong. Yup, it's the parents' fault."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you very much, ma'am."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "The world is really perfect the more happiness there is the more misfortune follows now let's talk about me I always make sure to do good deeds every day..."

name: Shiori
message: "...I'm sorry, it didn't go so well. But I did learn something useful."

name: Shiori
message: "Do you remember the high school girl who jumped? The one from my Death Diary?"

name: Shiori
message: "Her name was Kirishiki Nagisa. She's not me, but she might be Gyaruko-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, no. That would be way too convenient. Still, she could be her friend or something."

name: Shiori
message: "This might be the key to reclaiming her memories. We should tell her about it the next time we see her."

name: Shiori
message: "The lady talked about other things too, but none of them seemed relevant... I think."

name: Shiori
message: "She just kept rambling on and on, so I couldn't really register everything she said... though there was one thing that bothered me."

name: Shiori
message: "You know, I can't help but wonder if she's forgotten that she's dead."

name: Shiori
message: "She said she ate cookies yesterday, but that can't be true."

name: Shiori
message: "Ever since I became a ghost, my appetite has completely vanished."

name: Shiori
message: "I did try eating once, out of curiosity... but I ended up spitting it back out."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, it was grass, by the way. I can't really get actual food, so I just picked some weeds and tried eating them."

name: Shiori
message: "I think the result would've been the same with actual food. My body would probably just reject it as a foreign substance."

name: Shiori
message: "If she really did eat those cookies, the same thing should've happened to her."

name: Shiori
message: "But she talked about the taste too, so she must honestly believe she ate those cookies."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe her awareness that she's dead is fading, or maybe it's already gone."

name: Shiori
message: "...Right, we're dead, so no matter how much we eat, our souls can't absorb any of it."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... I think I finally understand what Ms. Librarian meant."

name: Shiori
message: "We ghosts can't get nourishment from food. That's why... we need a fixation, an obsession."

name: Shiori
message: "We need to gather our own strength, we can't maintain ourselves otherwise."

name: Shiori
message: "That's probably how it works."

name: Shiori
message: "...Sorry, I've gotten off topic. Anyway, what I wanted to say is:"

message: "Making that lady realize she's dead might set her off."

name: Shiori
message: "We should keep that in mind, so we don't bring it up carelessly from now on."

message: "So?"

message: "Huh?"

message: "Even in death, she wanders, searching for her lost child... for all eternity."

message: "This rumor is mainly about the mother, but the child she lost might lead you to the answer you're searching for."

message: "Or was that not what you were after? I mean, you're looking for a little girl, and not a baby..."

message: "...If you're done here, then leave. I have no intention of getting friendly with you."

message: "You'd best watch your back. Even I don't know what dangers await."

message: "Okay. We'll definitely come back and tell you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Then we have a deal. Now go, the wraiths of the dark are picking up your scent."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. Well then, we'll be back."

name: Shiori
message: "Kashima Reiko-san really is a nice person. She's very kind."

message: "Though what worries me is that Kashima Reiko-san hasn't checked it out yet."

message: "It'd be fine if it were just a rumor, but if it's real, we won't know what dangers are waiting or how to avoid them."

name: Shiori
message: "A big parking lot near a large park... This should be the place."

name: Shiori
message: "She said there's a flashy—"

name: Shiori
message: "Look. That must be her."

name: Shiori
message: "She looks flashy, but not quite. Is this what they call 'jirai-kei'? Her outfit really stands out."

name: Shiori
message: "I... can also feel it somehow. She's a ghost, just like me."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm a little on guard because of our experience with that lady, but Gyaruko-san *did* recommend her, so... she must be a nice person... right?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Okay, let's try talking to her."
"Hello."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, I know this is a bit sudden, but... you're a ghost, aren't you? I'm a ghost too."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I'm the only one who's a ghost, by the way. My buddy here is still alive. It's a long story."

name: Shiori
message: "Um... Right, I'll keep it short."

name: Shiori
message: "A certain ghost told us you're very knowledgeable, so we were hoping you might be able to help us too."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...Me? Help you?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, only if you want to, though."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...Did that 'certain ghost' not tell you, then?"

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "I am a sinner, one who bears all the sins of this world."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Get involved with me... and I might just drag you down into the depths of the everdarkness as well."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Do you two have that resolve?"
"Yes."
"No."

name: Shiori
message: "Th-That was fast... You never hesitate, do you?"

name: Shiori
message: "I... feel the same. I'm willing to do everything I can to get my memories back."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...Memories, huh."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "So? What do you want?"

name: Shiori
message: "So you'll help us? Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "We're looking for the ghost of a little girl. Have you seen her anywhere, or have any idea where she might be?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "I see, so you—"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...Huh? Y-You don't?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Um, did you not have a response ready in case we said no?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "If you do not have the resolve... then I can only lend you aid befitting that."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... I thought you were going to turn us down... You're so nice."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...So? What do you want?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, um, we're looking for a ghost. Specifically, a little girl."

name: Shiori
message: "Have you seen her anywhere, or have any idea where she might be?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "But first, allow me to correct your misunderstanding."

name: Shiori
message: "And that is?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "I am well-versed in urban legends, not ghosts in general."

name: Shiori
message: "Urban legends... like Kuchisake-onna?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Yes. I'm an expert on ghosts and apparitions of that sort, but I have no interest in ordinary spirits."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... ghosts and apparitions related to urban legends. I wonder if that little girl could be one of those..."

name: Shiori
message: "Actually, do you know about any urban legends that involve children?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "That ghost of yours... If you're looking for her, does that mean she's moving around?"

name: Shiori
message: "That's... right. We saw her once at a nearby park, but she disappeared right away."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "In short, she isn't the type that only appears in one set location, like Hanako-san of the Toilet or a Zashiki-warashi..."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "One rumor does come to mind... but it's not centered around the ghost child, and I haven't verified if it's true."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Is that okay with you?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, of course."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Go straight that way, and you'll reach the main street."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "From there, head straight north, and you'll see a housing complex."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "They say something roams around there."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "A ghost of a woman, pushing an empty baby stroller."

name: Shiori
message: "An empty stroller..."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Even in death, she wanders, searching for her lost child... for all eternity."

name: Shiori
message: "She lost her child? That's so sad..."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "This rumor is mainly about the mother, but the child she lost might lead you to the answer you're looking for."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Or was that not what you were after? I mean, you're looking for a little girl, and not a baby..."

name: Shiori
message: "Kids can still ride in strollers until they're four or five, right? From the way she looked... she was probably around that age."

name: Shiori
message: "I think it's entirely possible that the lost child is her. Thanks for telling us."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...If you're done here, then leave. I have no intention of getting friendly with you."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "You'd best watch your back. Even I don't know what dangers await."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, we'll be extra careful. Thank you, really."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right. What should we call you?"

name: Shiori
message: "Since we're ghosts, I guess it's better if we don't know your real name, but... would it be okay if I gave you some kind of nickname?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Anything's fine, but if I had to pick..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Kashima, Reiko."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Call me Kashima Reiko."

name: Shiori
message: "Kashima-san, then."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Kashima Reiko."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Call me Kashima Reiko."

name: Shiori
message: "Kashima-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "Reiko-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "Kashima Reiko-san?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Yes, that'll do."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, got it, As for me—"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Don't. Don't make me shoulder any more sins."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You are merely passing by, a ghost with no relation to me."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Understood?"

name: Shiori
message: "Um... Yes, I understand."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now go, before I rob you of your lives."

name: Shiori
message: "......Okay then, thank you for the info."
"Thank you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I don't need your thanks. I merely helped you on a whim."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now go. I have nothing more to say."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Was there anything else?"

name: Shiori
message: "Is there anything you want, Kashima Reiko-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm always relying on everyone's kindness, but I never manage to repay them."

name: Shiori
message: "So I thought I'd ask, before I forget."

name: Shiori
message: "Is there anything I can do for you?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I have no need for your gratitude."

name: Shiori
message: "Hmm~... Ah, I know. In that case, why don't we turn it into a deal?"

name: Shiori
message: "You tell us about urban legends, and we'll do something in return as payment."

name: Shiori
message: "Well? Do we have a deal?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Then tell me."

name: Shiori
message: "Sure, about what?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "About the urban legend. Whether you actually encountered it. And if you did, what happened."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I am bound to this place. So you shall act as my eyes. Tell me everything you see."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "That should suffice."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. I'll definitely come back and tell you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Then we have a deal. Now go, the wraiths of the dark are picking up your scent."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. Well then, we'll be back."

name: Shiori
message: "...She acted like she was pushing us away, but she was actually really kind. I feel like we'll get along well."

name: Shiori
message: "Urban legends, huh... so that's what Gyaruko-san meant by 'knowledgeable in a different way.'"

name: Shiori
message: "The ghost of a mother pushing an empty stroller... I wonder if that'll lead us to the kid we're looking for."

name: Shiori
message: "It could be a bust, though... We're not even sure if it's real or not."

name: Shiori
message: "Kashima Reiko-san also said she didn't know what dangers await, so the ghost might even attack us."

name: Shiori
message: "It's pretty risky, so I think we shouldn't prioritize it too much."

name: Shiori
message: "But... I *am* kind of interested in urban legends. No, sorry, I think my curiosity is getting the better of me."

name: Shiori
message: "If you're interested too, we could check it out."

name: Shiori
message: "After all, we did make a deal with her... though I did go ahead and decide everything on my own."

name: Shiori
message: "A place filled with people... The first thing that comes to mind is the flower garden. But maybe I'm still hung up on that accident site yesterday."

name: Shiori
message: "This seems to be the only place around here where a kid could have fun."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe the locals don't actually come here much. As for me, I've only been here once—on a field trip back in elementary school..."

name: Shiori
message: "Wow, that memory resurfaced out of nowhere."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't remember the details, but I think it simply wasn't memorable enough for me. I probably wasn't very interested in plants or flowers."

name: Shiori
message: "...Somehow, I think I'm remembering more through our small talk than actually dying."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, does that mean I never had to die again and again in the first place?"

name: Shiori
message: "If that's true, then the premise of me being fixated on death completely falls apart. The idea is starting to scare me, so let's just head in."

name: Shiori
message: "If I remember right, entry's free, I think... Yeah, we're good. Let's go."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sure I've been here before, and yet..."

name: Shiori
message: "It doesn't feel nostalgic at all. I must really have had no interest in plants..."

name: Shiori
message: "But it sure is nice and quiet here. It's not as crowded as I expected, and the flowers are pretty."

name: Shiori
message: "I pretty much praised the flowers just now, but honestly, they didn't move me in the slightest."

name: Shiori
message: "I wonder what that says about me as a person. That... kinda stings."

name: Shiori
message: "What about you? Do you like these kinds of places?"
"I like them."
"Not really."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... I... may not have been the classiest person. I'd probably pick sweets over flowers."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, no, it must be because I'm dead. Right, I'm a ghost now, so I must've lost that part of me. I'm sure of it."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, let's just go with that."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, really? Ehehe, I'm relieved. We're the same, then."

name: Shiori
message: "I mean, I do think they're pretty, but not enough that I'd look at them fondly or anything."

name: Shiori
message: "I was surprised at how indifferent I felt, but that's completely normal, right? Normal. Right, no problem at all."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, we're here to look for the girl, not admire the flowers."

name: Shiori
message: "How about we circle around for now?"

name: Shiori
message: "I wasn't expecting much, but she really is nowhere to be found."

name: Shiori
message: "This place is huge, after all. Without a lead, we'll just be wasting our time."

name: Shiori
message: "Although... Look, over there. She's not our ghost, but... I have to wonder—am I the one attracting them, or are you?"

name: Shiori
message: "That woman on the bench. Can you see her?"

name: Shiori
message: "I have a feeling... she's a ghost, just like me."

name: Shiori
message: "After running into all these ghosts everywhere we go, I'm starting to think it's more than a coincidence, like it's fate or something."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's try talking to her. She might know something about our ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll speak to her first. We don't know what her triggers are, so you should wait here for now."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, I'm off."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."

name: Shiori
message: "Do you have a moment? I'd like to ask you something..."

name: Shiori
message: "Um, the truth is, I'm a ghost. Are you, uh..."

name: Shiori
message: "If you'll excuse me, then..."

name: Shiori
message: "Mind if I correct myself? She might not be a ghost after all... She didn't react at all when I talked to her."

name: Shiori
message: "I wonder... Ah, I knew it... she really is a ghost..."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't quite explain it, but she doesn't feel like a living person. It's as if... she's giving me goosebumps? Like the air around her is chilly."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... but if there are people who can see ghosts and people who can't, then maybe there are ghosts who can't see ghosts too."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, can you try talking to her?"

name: Shiori
message: "She might respond to you."
"Hello."
"Hello."
"Hello."
(Do a threatening anteater pose)

name: Shiori
message: "Welcome back. Looks like she didn't react to you either."

name: Shiori
message: "Welcome back. It seems even your most threatening pose didn't get a reaction... That was so awkward... I get it..."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe... she's starting to fade already."

name: Shiori
message: "First, your memories, next, your ego... Maybe she doesn't even have the energy to react anymore..."

name: Shiori
message: "Somehow, I can't think of it as someone else's problem."

name: Shiori
message: "If we ever find anything that might be connected to her, maybe we should come back here. If her memories return, then maybe..."

name: Shiori
message: "But without us knowing what she actually wants, we might just end up imposing on her. Now, what to do..."

name: Shiori
message: "It doesn't look like our little ghost is here too, so let's move on."

name: Shiori
message: "This must be the housing complex Kashima Reiko-san mentioned."

name: Shiori
message: "She said the ghost shows up somewhere around here, but I wonder if there are conditions to make her show up."

name: Shiori
message: "For example, what if it only appears at night, or if there's some specific procedure we have to follow? We might just be wasting our time."

name: Shiori
message: "And since Kashima Reiko-san hasn't confirmed whether the urban legend is actually real, she probably doesn't know much either..."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's just look around for a bit and leave if we don't find anything."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... over there."

name: Shiori
message: "It's a woman pushing a baby stroller... We found her, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, she's not our ghost. She's just a normal, living person."

name: Shiori
message: "And look, you can see the baby's feet. It's not empty."

name: Shiori
message: "Now that I think about it, it's not really strange. I mean, there are plenty of women pushing baby strollers around this area..."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd be rude if we just sprang up on her out of nowhere, so let's not do anything too hasty."

name: Shiori
message: "We've been staring too much. Let's go."

name: Shiori
message: "A-Ah."

name: Shiori
message: "She's coming this way..."

name: Mother
message: "Hello."
"Hello."

name: Mother
message: "Look, Micchan! Two friends came to see you~"

name: Shiori
message: "Micchan... hm? Huh? Two...?"

name: Mother
message: "Come on, Micchan, say hello to the lady and her friend~"

name: Shiori
message: "The lady... Sh-She can see me..."
There's a doll sitting in the stroller.

name: Mother
message: "Micchan, say hello~. Ehehe, how nice~"

name: Mother
message: "Can you two call her name too? It'll make her very happy~!"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, ummm..."
"Micchan."

name: Mother
message: "Oh~, ehehe~, doesn't that make you happy~?"

name: Mother
message: "Look at her smile! She's beaming."

name: Mother
message: "Thank you, you two. Come see us again, okay?"

name: Mother
message: "Thank you, you two. But I'm sorry, we have to go shopping now. We really appreciate it, though."

name: Mother
message: "If you don't mind, we'd love it if you came to see us again."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, yes..."

name: Mother
message: "Make sure to get home before it gets dark. This place can be surprisingly dangerous."

name: Mother
message: "Micchan, say goodbye to your friends now~. Bye bye~!"
"Bye-bye."

name: Mother
message: "Ehehehe, see you again."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah—s-sorry, my brain just froze trying to process all that... Your quick thinking really saved us back there..."

name: Shiori
message: "The baby in her stroller... that was a doll, wasn't it?"

name: Shiori
message: "She could even see me... No, I mean, some people can see ghosts, so that's fine and all, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "I think... she's who the urban legend was based on."

name: Shiori
message: "This isn't the kind of thing we should dig into just because we're curious..."

name: Shiori
message: "Even if she *was* connected to our ghost, I don't think we should go poking into someone's wounds. Let's leave her alone."

name: Shiori
message: "......I wonder if she lost her child."

name: Shiori
message: "The Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case... maybe—no, what am I saying? I just said we shouldn't poke into her wounds."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's report back to Kashima Reiko-san. It's a shame, but we didn't find any clues or urban legends, huh?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "So it wasn't a ghost, but one of the living..."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes... I think she's dealing with something very serious."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "To take the pain of a grieving woman and spread it as an urban legend for cheap amusement... How revolting."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And I, who fell for that disgusting rumor... am just as revolting. My sins run deep."

name: Shiori
message: "This kind of thing has probably been happening since forever."

name: Shiori
message: "We should keep this rumor to ourselves... The more it spreads, the more it'll hurt her."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Of course. An urban legend without a supernatural core has no value."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I can't believe I gave you such a worthless lead. I've wronged you two."

name: Shiori
message: "No, I'm the one who's sorry. I insisted it had to involve children, which made you share a rumor you haven't even verified yet."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'll let you in on one more thing."

name: Shiori
message: "Hm?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If I leave it like this, it'll hurt my reputation. I remembered something related to children, so I'll tell you as an apology. No payment needed."

name: Shiori
message: "Are you sure? Thank you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "But I have one condition."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'm only telling you as information. Do not attempt it yourselves."

name: Shiori
message: "So it's that dangerous..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Yes. You might never come back."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "There are countless urban legends about slipping into other worlds. This town itself has several."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Some are easy to return from... while others are extremely difficult, or outright impossible."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "What I'm about to tell you is the latter. The steps to reach it are simple, which means someone could fulfill it by accident."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Do you know about that case a few years ago, the one where a lot of children went missing?"

name: Shiori
message: "You mean... the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I don't know what the public calls it... but I believe it was caused by this urban legend."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "In short, a classic case of spiriting away."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "They wandered into another world, and only their bodies returned."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "They were killed by an aberration, which was why the police couldn't do anything."

name: Shiori
message: "If the urban legend is behind it, then... that does explain why they never caught the culprit..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The girl you're looking for might have been spirited away, then killed."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "But unlike the others, only her ghost returned, and her body's still there."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Of course, that's assuming the urban legend is actually real."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I obviously didn't test it, but I believe the possibility is very high."

name: Shiori
message: "It seems you have a reason to think that."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The more people believe in an urban legend, the more likely it is to come into being."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "This one was first verified in the 1990s... during the second occult boom."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It was a huge hit among the local elementary school kids."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And it was no coincidence. I remember because it happened right next to that housing complex."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Did you see that crosswalk across the main street in front of the housing complex?"

name: Shiori
message: "Um... Yes, I think."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You have to cross it stepping only on the white lines. Step off, and you end up in the mirror world."

name: Shiori
message: "The... mirror world?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Think of it as a world that's just next to the afterlife. It could be hell, or another place entirely. But the point is, it's another world."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's a typical urban legend, where you sprinkle the occult onto a common children's game."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "But the thing is... it was right next to a housing complex, so a lot of kids must've lived nearby. And that crosswalk was part of their school route, meaning a lot of kids passed through."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "A bunch of things overlapped, and it caught the elementary schoolers' attention."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And back then, a lot of people believed in Nostradamus' prophecy. The occult felt part of everyday life."

name: Shiori
message: "Which was why it boomed, and turned into the real thing."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Exactly. It's died down now, but I remember it was still being whispered in some circles back when I was alive."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "People don't believe in it like they used to. But that's true of most urban legends."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Although weakened, plenty of aberrations born in the 70s through the 90s still exist today."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's very possible that this one is still spiriting kids away, even if it isn't as strong as it used to be."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's also possible that it went dormant. Until something woke it up."

name: Shiori
message: "I see, so you're saying that 'something' woke it up five years ago, which led to all those disappearances..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "That is all I can tell you. Your ghost may have been one of the victims. I can't tell you anything else."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

message: "Huh?"

name: Shiori

name: Shiori
message: "Sh-Should we pretend we didn't hear you just now...?"

name: Kashima, Reiko

name: Shiori
message: "I know this place."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes... I've been here before."

name: Shiori
message: "I know it well..."

name: Shiori
message: "When I was little... there used to be a slide here."

name: Shiori
message: "But at some point... it got removed. And then, only the swings and the sandbox were left..."

name: Shiori
message: "Right, this bench. I used to sit here and..."

name: Shiori
message: "Sit here and..."

name: Shiori
message: "I was... I was sitting here, I think..."

name: Shiori
message: "Watching... watching something..."

name: Shiori
message: "Watching what? It must've been something important..."

name: Shiori
message: "...I can't remember. Why?"

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, I know we just got here, but... there's somewhere I want to go."

name: Shiori
message: "It's close by. Follow me."

name: Shiori
message: "......There it is."

name: Shiori
message: "This is the apartment building I used to live in."

name: Shiori
message: "My memories are coming back... piece by piece. Yes, I used to live here."

name: Shiori
message: "If I remember right, it was a corner room... and the number was..."

name: Shiori
message: "401... Yeah, I think it was 401. I'm not completely sure, though..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right, the mailbox—something with a name on it..."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't see much through the slit..."

name: Shiori
message: "We should try opening it. The dial lock, if I remember... first a 2... or was it an 8...?"

name: Shiori
message: "No good. I can't remember at all."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry for all the mumbling. I'm a little desperate right now."

name: Shiori
message: "If I can figure out the room, then maybe my memories will..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I know! I can stick my hand through. I should be using my ghost powers."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay... phase my hand in... and let my fingers touch the inside..."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, that sounds so complicated. Can I even pull that off?"

name: Shiori
message: "No, I'm pulling this off. I'm really sorry, I'm kinda panicking right now."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, there. I got it. This is... the electric bill notice. And it's addressed to..."

name: Shiori
message: "Not Kugayama... Did I mess up the number? Could this be the wrong room?"

name: Shiori
message: "...No, it's 401. I'm sure I got it right."

name: Shiori
message: "Which means..."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... My family doesn't live here anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "...Did they move out? Or... maybe they're already dead?"

name: Shiori
message: "My family was..."

name: Shiori
message: "Dad, Mom... and me..."

name: Shiori
message: "No, I'm missing someone... There was one more..."

name: Shiori
message: "My little sister."

name: Shiori
message: "Right, I had a little sister."

name: Shiori
message: "Dad, Mom, me, and a little sister much younger than me."

name: Shiori
message: "A little sister...?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry. Can we go back to that park one more time?"

name: Shiori
message: "So much came back all at once—I need to sort it out."

name: Shiori
message: "If my memory is right, then I..."

name: Shiori
message: "Right, there's no doubt."

name: Shiori
message: "I used to bring my little sister here all the time."

name: Shiori
message: "I'd sit on this bench, watching her play in the sandbox..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'd gently push her back and forth on the swing..."

name: Shiori
message: "I died here."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't explain it, but... I'm sure of it. My life ended here."

name: Shiori
message: "But... I still can't remember why I died."

name: Shiori
message: "I'd never have come to the park alone. I was always with my sister."

name: Shiori
message: "Does that mean I was the only one who died? Or..."

name: Shiori
message: "Was that ghost girl... my little sister?"

name: Shiori
message: "...I can't remember. My family's faces, their names. The most important things are still missing..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll try dying here again."

name: Shiori
message: "Would you mind taking a picture like always?"
(Take a photo)

name: Shiori
message: "Thanks."

name: Shiori
message: "There's... one thing I realized."

name: Shiori
message: "I... probably didn't kill myself."

name: Shiori
message: "We still don't know what happened, but I'm certain it wasn't suicide."

name: Shiori
message: "I must have been caught up in something. An incident, or an accident maybe..."

name: Shiori
message: "If that's the case, then maybe my sister and I... were there together...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Was I the only one who became a ghost... or did she, too...?"

name: Shiori
message: "That girl... her age matches... I think..."

name: Shiori
message: "A little girl... the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Would it be too much of a stretch to link them? I can't imagine myself being one of the victims..."

name: Shiori
message: "Then maybe... there was some kind of accident here..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, sorry. I was lost in thought."

name: Shiori
message: "It's a shame, but it doesn't look like I'll remember anything more here."

name: Shiori
message: "...The sun's setting. We should head back."

name: Shiori
message: "Thanks again for today, for sticking with me."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, then where did this rope come from?"

name: Shiori
message: "Hold on. I used it to hang myself with it like it was normal, but what even is this rope?"
"It just popped out."
"Dunno."

name: Shiori
message: "Did I... create it? Out of thin air? How scary..."

name: Shiori
message: "Come to think of it, when we first met, I was hanging myself with this same weird rope too..."

name: Shiori
message: "I did it on pure instinct... Why am I only questioning it now...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe it's one of those soul accessories Gyaruko-san mentioned. Does that mean mine's a rope? That's even scarier..."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, it doesn't matter. It's not like thinking about it is going to give me any answers."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, let's head back before it gets dark."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay... that should do it."

name: Shiori
message: "We made a lot of progress today. I remembered so much."

name: Shiori
message: "If my family hadn't moved away, I might have remembered everything. We were so close... It really is a shame."

name: Shiori
message: "Or maybe they never moved in the first place."

name: Shiori
message: "I should stop being so pessimistic. We *are* making progress, after all."

name: Shiori
message: "You know... maybe it's not that my memories are gone, but that I just don't know how to draw them out."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe that's why they suddenly pop up during mundane moments."

name: Shiori
message: "It never happened before, but walking around with you and talking like this... it feels like my memories are slowly sorting themselves out."

name: Shiori
message: "If only we could find that girl..."

name: Shiori
message: "I want to look deeper into the case too. The Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case, I mean."

name: Shiori
message: "It's not that I think I was involved, but more that I want to be sure I wasn't."

name: Shiori
message: "If the case had nothing to do with me, then my sister probably had nothing to do with it either."

name: Shiori
message: "But... that still doesn't mean she didn't die. She could've died with me, in some other incident, or accident..."

name: Shiori
message: "I have to find out how I died."

name: Shiori
message: "If I figure that out, then I might know what happened to my sister—to my family."

name: Shiori
message: "I think... we're almost there. Let's continue next time."

name: Shiori
message: "We should stop here for today. See you, and thanks for today. Get home safe, okay?"

message: "You cross the white lines on the crosswalk without stepping off. If you misstep, you fall into the mirror world, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "Otherwise, nothing happens... That means, we're going to step off on purpose."

name: Shiori
message: "I've been wondering... aren't the conditions for entering the mirror world too easy?"

name: Shiori
message: "I mean, most people step off the white lines by their first or second step. Nobody ever tries to walk only on the lines unless they're doing it intentionally."

name: Shiori
message: "There must be another condition. Maybe... you have to stay on the white lines until you're halfway through, and only then will the rumor take effect."

name: Shiori
message: "And if you step off right from the start, the rumor doesn't activate, and you won't end up in the mirror world. If that weren't the case, there'd be so many missing people by now."

name: Shiori
message: "You know the rumor, you try it, and then you mess up. That seems more likely to be the real procedure for falling into the mirror world."

name: Shiori
message: "Now that I think about it—nobody would purposely try to fail unless they were messing around."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe that's why there hasn't been a mass disappearance, even if it's easy to activate. Anyone who believes in it would be too scared to actually try it."

name: Shiori
message: "...Huh. I'm getting a little too into this. I think I'm on a roll with this analysis."

name: Shiori
message: "Still, if we're doing this, we should do it seriously. Come on, let's try it."
